text:
alex_finance: Quick procurement ping  Need a concise head-to-head: QuantaLedger vs QuantaLogic for ML billing — invoice granularity, rounding, and dispute windows. cc @sasha_procurement

sasha_procurement: We care about commits vs PAYG. Which vendor offers overage caps? Which one shows per-model SKUs on invoices?

jamie_engineering: Our footprint: ~5M gen tokens/mo, 200k embeddings, short spikes to ~120 RPS. Note: we batch embeddings heavily.

nora_audit: Audit asks: do they round to token buckets (e.g., 1k), or bill exact? Also how are retro adjustments applied (credit memo vs future credit)?

henry_sales: From initial quotes: QuantaLogic offers a 12% commit discount + optional 125% overage cap. QuantaLedger does tiered pricing with monthly true-up and 30-day dispute window.

sasha_procurement: I'll build a 6-month TCO (PAYG vs 12mo commit) and flag sensitivity if embeddings billed per-vector vs per-call. Will follow up with vendors for clarifications and post answers here. :+1:
